description: Chunk names already encode the max contained version (inverted, base36) — the exact predicate a read needs (max >= target). But read_from_version lists ALL chunks and header-GETs each one to learn min/max: 1 LIST + N GETs per cold read, growing with shard lifetime, paid on every ShardServer chunk-path pull. Fix: parse max from the key name; the needed set is the leading run of the ascending listing while name-max >= target (take_while — also stops paged listing early); GET only chunks actually read. seek/find likewise: candidate = smallest name-max >= target, one chunk read to confirm. O(needed) instead of O(lifetime).
title: ChunkReader selects chunks from key names; no per-chunk header reads
